dedupe_keys.name: nppad nuclear power plant accident data simulated time series of accidents in pressurised water reactor plants

description: NPPAD, the Nuclear Power Plant Accident Data set, is an open collection of simulated time series covering most of the common types of accidents that can occur in typical pressurised water reactor nuclear power plants. The figshare records read through the figshare API on 2026-09-26 give one dataset item, a single RAR file of about 813 MB, posted on 12 December 2022 under CC0 by Ben Qi, Xingyu Xiao, Jingang Liang, Li-chi Po and Jiejuan Tong, with the Scientific Data descriptor as the linked article. Coverage is generic pressurised water reactor plants, not a named site. Access is free download from figshare with no registration; the format is a RAR archive, so the file layout and variables are documented in the data descriptor, not on the landing page. Caveats: the records are simulated, not measured plant data, so any model trained on them inherits the simulator's assumptions; the collection has not been revised since 2022, and the figshare landing page is rendered by script, so it was read through the API. Simulation uses are training and testing accident diagnosis and prediction models, benchmarking cascading failure sequences in plant systems, and supporting emergency response decision tools. Related records: platform-pctran-nuclear-plant-simulator is a desktop simulator of such plants, and model-emrald-dynamic-pra models accident sequences probabilistically.
